headlines.headline: Thunder's Ty Jerome drops career-high 45 as OKC leans on bench amid injury wave
headlines.detail: With Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace both out after surgery, reserve guard Ty Jerome erupted for a career-high 45 points to carry Oklahoma City, underscoring how thin the defending champions' depth has gotten.

headlines.headline: Cardinals ship Marvin Harrison Jr. to Texans as trade deadline buzz builds toward Nov. 10
headlines.detail: Arizona traded 2024 first-round receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. to Houston in one of the first major moves of trade-deadline season, with the Giants and Steelers also already active ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline.

headlines.headline: Ohio State survives Indiana 19-15, snapping Hoosiers' 22-game win streak
headlines.detail: Ohio State held off previously unbeaten Indiana in the week's marquee Big Ten clash, ending Indiana's 22-game winning streak and reshuffling the conference's College Football Playoff picture.

headlines.headline: Defending champ Michigan tumbles to No. 16 in preseason AP poll after Dusty May's departure
headlines.detail: Florida debuts at No. 1 for the first time since 2006, with Duke at No. 2, while reigning national champion Michigan fell to No. 16 after coach Dusty May left for SMU in the offseason.
